approved_by: user, 2026-10-08, before any event signal-return relationship was examined
contract: docs/specs/V8_CONTRACT_20261008.json (verify() before any run); event inputs nn_meta/validation/v8-events-20261008-r0 (every row has available_at_utc)
question: Do literature-backed event/attention signals, traded long-only on the V8 universe with realistic costs, beat QQQ, XLK, SPY and the equal-weight universe out of sample?
engine: nn_meta.v8_engine daily timeframe (stage-1 rules): 10 slots, each entry 1/10 of equity, execution at the next trading day's 10:30 ET bar open, admission panel, forced exits, nn_meta.v8_fills costs at 1.0x and 1.5x. Entry priority adv20 except H3 (lowest short-pressure z first).

timing.event_signal_bar: for an event public at time tau: the signal bar is the trading day before the first trading day whose 10:00 ET is at or after tau (so it executes at that day's 10:30)
timing.reaction_day: H1: first trading day whose 16:00 ET close is after tau; the signal bar is that day
timing.holding: exit signal when H bars have passed since the most recent entry signal for that name (a newer signal extends the hold); an exit signal also cancels a not-yet-filled entry

abnormal_return: adjusted close-to-close return minus the equal-weight admitted-universe return of the same day

H1_post_earnings_drift.support: Bernard & Thomas (1989); Chan, Jegadeesh & Lakonishok (1996); weakening reported since
H1_post_earnings_drift.events: 8-K with Item 2.02 (144 names; foreign 6-K filers excluded)
H1_post_earnings_drift.H1a_reaction: abnormal return on the reaction day in the top tercile of all earnings reactions with reaction day in the prior 365 days (>= 30 such events, else no signal); hold H in {20, 60}
H1_post_earnings_drift.H1b_sue: first-reported quarterly diluted EPS (us-gaap EarningsPerShareDiluted, 80-100 day duration) from XBRL facts; SUE = (EPS_q - EPS_q-4) / std of the prior 8 such year-over-year changes (>= 4); event time = availability of the first report of EPS_q; SUE in the top tercile of SUEs available in the prior 365 days (>= 30); hold H in {20, 60}

H2_insider_cluster.events: open-market purchases (transaction code P, acquired) not flagged as Rule 10b5-1 plans
H2_insider_cluster.signal: when a qualifying filing becomes public and >= k distinct reporting owners have such purchases with transaction dates in the prior 30 calendar days (counting only filings already public); k in {2, 3}; hold H in {21, 63}

H3_low_short_pressure.data: FINRA daily short volume / total volume; day d usable for the next day's 10:30 execution
H3_low_short_pressure.signal: on the last trading day of each week, z = (mean ratio over the last w days - mean over the prior 60 days) / std over the prior 60 days, admitted names only; entry signal for the 10 lowest z; exit signal for held names not among the M lowest; w in {5, 10}, M in {10, 20}; entry priority lowest z

H4_attention.H4a_news_continuation: support Chan (2003): abnormal return on day d / std of the prior 60 days of abnormal returns >= theta, return > 0, and >= 1 Alpaca news article created between the prior close and d's close; theta in {2, 3}; hold 21
H4_attention.H4b_wikipedia_spike: support Da, Engelberg & Gao (2011): page views of day d / median of the prior 20 days >= m with that median >= 100 views; m in {3, 5}; hold 10

evaluation.selection: within each hypothesis, the variant with the highest in-sample annualized Sharpe and >= 30 in-sample round trips (none eligible: the fold counts as not beating)

per_hypothesis_all_required.beat_benchmarks: selected variant's fold return exceeds every benchmark in >= 4 of 6 folds at cost 1.0x
per_hypothesis_all_required.deflated_sharpe: probability >= 0.95 for its concatenated out-of-sample daily returns, N = 16 (all variants)

shared_gates_all_16_variants.rank_persistence: Spearman(in-sample, out-of-sample Sharpe) across eligible variants positive in >= 4 of 6 folds and median >= 0.10
shared_gates_all_16_variants.pbo: CSCV PBO < 0.5 over 2021-05-03..2025-12-31 daily returns, 16 blocks

pass_rules.verdict: a hypothesis passes only if its own rules and both shared gates pass

holdout: 2026 is not read. A passing hypothesis gets one confirmation run on 2026 only if the user approves spending it.
